source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
These apply to any enemy unit for as long as it is within **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** of your **FORTIFICATIONS** and of none of your other units:

- it can still be picked as a target for ranged attacks, but each such attack not made with a **[[PISTOL]](vsdata:weapon-ability/pistol)** gets -1 to its **[Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)**
- its models that [Fall Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) while **Battle-shocked** skip the **[Desperate Escape Test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape)**, apart from any model whose move crosses enemy models
